title: Is Malaysia actually using AI?
subtitle: 21.8% of working-age Malaysians use AI tools, 51st in the world, a third of Singapore's rate, and climbing every quarter.
question: How many Malaysians use AI, and how does Malaysia compare?
answer: It depends how you measure it. Microsoft's AI Diffusion data (Q1 2026) estimates 21.8% of working-age Malaysians use AI tools, 51st of 147 economies, behind Singapore (63.4%) and Vietnam (26.5%) but ahead of the Philippines, Indonesia and Thailand. Local surveys read higher: Vodus found 67% of Malaysians say they used AI in the past 3 months, led by 25–34-year-olds. Both agree on the direction: adoption is rising every quarter.

takeaways: By the strictest comparable measure, **21.8% of working-age Malaysians use AI tools** — ranking **#51 of 147 economies** (Microsoft AI Diffusion, Q1 2026).
**Singapore (63.4%) is in another league** — nearly 3× Malaysia's rate and #2 in the world. **Vietnam (26.5%) has pulled ahead** with the region's fastest growth.
Malaysia still beats the **Philippines (20.1%), Indonesia (14.1%) and Thailand (12.4%)** — solidly mid-table in ASEAN, mid-table globally.

Ask Malaysians directly and the number jumps: **67% say they used AI in the past 3 months** (Vodus). Self-reported use of any AI reads higher than measured active use of AI tools, both are true, they measure different things.
The divide is **age, not access**: ~**85% of 25–34-year-olds** have used AI recently, versus only about a third of Malaysians **55 and older**.
The trend is the story: **+3.5 percentage points in nine months**, rising every quarter.

faq.a: About 21.8% of working-age Malaysians actively use AI tools as of Q1 2026, per Microsoft's AI Diffusion data, while 67% of Malaysians say they used AI at least once in the past 3 months, per the Vodus panel survey. The first measures regular tool use comparably across countries; the second is self-reported recent use.

faq.q: How does Malaysia compare to Singapore on AI adoption?
faq.a: Singapore's AI diffusion is 63.4% of working-age adults (2nd in the world); Malaysia's is 21.8% (51st of 147). Singapore's rate is nearly three times Malaysia's.

faq.q: Is Malaysia ahead of its neighbours on AI?
faq.a: Mid-table: behind Singapore (63.4%) and Vietnam (26.5%), ahead of the Philippines (20.1%), Indonesia (14.1%) and Thailand (12.4%), as of Q1 2026.

faq.q: Is AI adoption in Malaysia growing?
faq.a: Yes, from 18.3% (H1 2025) to 19.7% (H2 2025) to 21.8% (Q1 2026) of the working-age population, a gain of 3.5 percentage points in about nine months.

faq.q: Who uses AI most in Malaysia?
faq.a: Young working adults: about 85% of Malaysians aged 25–34 used AI in the past 3 months. Among those 55 and above, roughly two-thirds have not used it at all (Vodus, early 2026).

faq.q: Where does this data come from?
faq.a: Microsoft AI for Good Lab's AI Diffusion Report, published as an open, MIT-licensed CSV on GitHub (147 economies, updated roughly quarterly), plus the Vodus AI Usage in Malaysia 2026 panel survey. Every figure links to its source.
